# 🧬 MicroBioMeta ![MicroBioMeta logo](reference/figures/logo.jpg)

The goal of `MicroBioMeta` is to support beginners in microbiome data
analysis, whether working with metagenomic or metabarcoding datasets. It
enables users with limited experience in R to explore, visualize, and
analyze results with minimal coding and customization. This helps save
time on scripting, while still producing statistically robust results
and publication-ready figures in an intuitive and accessible way

## 👩‍💻 Contributors

- Stephanie Hereira - lead developer.
- Nina Montoya - co-developer and functions.
- Karla Zarco - co-developer and functions.

## 💻 Installation instructions

``` r

install.packages("devtools")
library(devtools)
install_github("Steph0522/MicroBioMeta")
library(MicroBioMeta)
```

## 📗 Examples

For examples and uses go to the [web
page](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/)

## 🙌 Code of Conduct

Please note that the `MicroBioMeta` project is released with a
[Contributor Code of
Conduct](http://bioconductor.org/about/code-of-conduct/). By
contributing to this project, you agree to abide by its terms.

## 🔨 Development tools

- Continuous code testing is possible thanks to [GitHub
  actions](https://www.tidyverse.org/blog/2020/04/usethis-1-6-0/)
  through *[usethis](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=usethis)*,
  *[remotes](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=remotes)*, and
  *[rcmdcheck](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=rcmdcheck)* customized
  to use [Bioconductor’s docker
  containers](https://www.bioconductor.org/help/docker/) and
  *[BiocCheck](https://bioconductor.org/packages/3.18/BiocCheck)*.
- Code coverage assessment is possible thanks to
  [codecov](https://codecov.io/gh) and
  *[covr](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=covr)*.
- The [documentation website](http://Steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta)
  is automatically updated thanks to
  *[pkgdown](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=pkgdown)*.
- The code is styled automatically thanks to
  *[styler](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=styler)*.
- The documentation is formatted thanks to
  *[devtools](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=devtools)* and
  *[roxygen2](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=roxygen2)*.

For more details, check the `dev` directory.

This package was developed using

# Package index

## Pre-processing data.

Functions used for pre process data.

- [`collapse_table()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/collapse_table.md)
  : Collapse table Collapse an OTU/ASV table by taxonomic level
- [`merge_feature_taxonomy()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/merge_feature_taxonomy.md)
  : Merge feature table and taxonomy
- [`from_phyloseq()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/from_phyloseq.md)
  : Convert a phyloseq object to MicroBioMeta tables
- [`from_tse()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/from_tse.md)
  : Convert a (Tree)SummarizedExperiment object to MicroBioMeta tables

## Abundance visualizations

Functions used for abundance visualizations.

- [`abundance_bar_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/abundance_bar_plot.md)
  : Relative abundance barplot
- [`abundance_heatmap_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/abundance_heatmap_plot.md)
  : Heatmap of relative abundance
- [`abundance_sankey_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/abundance_sankey_plot.md)
  : Sankey diagram of relative abundances

## Alpha diversity

Functions used for alpha diversity index and analyses.

- [`alpha_hill_corr_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/alpha_hill_corr_plot.md)
  : Alpha diversity correlation plot
- [`alpha_hill_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/alpha_hill_plot.md)
  : Alpha diversity plot
- [`alpha_diversity_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/alpha_diversity_plot.md)
  : Alpha diversity plot
- [`alpha_decay_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/alpha_decay_plot.md)
  : Alpha diversity along a continuous gradient

## Beta diversity

Functions used for beta diversity analyses and visualizations.

- [`beta_ord_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/beta_ord_plot.md)
  : Beta diversity plot with multiple distance and ordination methods
- [`beta_dissimilarity_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/beta_dissimilarity_plot.md)
  : Beta Diversity Boxplot
- [`beta_turnover_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/beta_turnover_plot.md)
  : Box plot of beta diversity
- [`beta_partition_ord_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/beta_partition_ord_plot.md)
  : Beta diversity partition (Jaccard/Sorensen)
- [`beta_decay_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/beta_decay_plot.md)
  : Distance-decay of community similarity plot
- [`beta_test_table()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/beta_test_table.md)
  : Table of Permanova or Betadisper

## Important taxa

Functions used to identify important taxa

- [`aldex_heatmap_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/aldex_heatmap_plot.md)
  : ALDEx2 differential abundance heatmap
- [`aldex_volcano_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/aldex_volcano_plot.md)
  : This function generates either an effect size plot or a volcano plot
  based on ALDEx2 results.
- [`ancombc_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/ancombc_plot.md)
  : ANCOMBC2 differential abundance bar/heatmap plot
- [`random_forest_lollipop_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/random_forest_lollipop_plot.md)
  : Generate a Lollipop plot from random forest results
- [`ratios_bubble_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/ratios_bubble_plot.md)
  : Compare taxon abundance ratios between two conditions

## Other functions

Functions used for other analyses

- [`cca_rda_biplot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/cca_rda_biplot.md)
  : CCA/RDA Biplot with ggplot2
- [`corr_env_abund_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/corr_env_abund_plot.md)
  : Plot Correlation Between Environmental Variables and Taxonomic
  Groups
- [`venn_plot()`](https://steph0522.github.io/MicroBioMeta/reference/venn_plot.md)
  : Generate a Venn diagram of taxa shared between sample groups
